title: Toilet Paper Shoe Air Force One
description_short: Trump walked up Air Force One stairs with toilet paper stuck to his shoe, completely unaware for several minutes.
description_medium: On October 4, 2018, Donald Trump boarded Air Force One at Minneapolis–Saint Paul Airport with a piece of white paper caught under his shoe. The New York Post said it could have been toilet paper, a napkin or another scrap; Yahoo identified it as toilet paper. The brief scene prompted jokes online.
description_long: On October 4, 2018, Donald Trump boarded Air Force One at Minneapolis–Saint Paul Airport with a loose piece of white paper trailing from the sole of his shoe. The New York Post described the scrap as possibly toilet paper, a napkin or another piece of paper, while Yahoo identified it as toilet paper. The paper came off as Trump approached the aircraft and remained on the stairs; Yahoo reported that a staff member picked it up. Photos and video of the boarding moment circulated online and drew jokes from commentators. The coverage documents a brief public mishap during presidential travel, rather than an event with a policy or security consequence. The reports differ on what the scrap was and do not establish how long Trump noticed—or failed to notice—it. The populated card summary says he was unaware for several minutes, a duration the linked reporting does not support. The precise description is that a paper scrap was visible as he boarded.
